answer_1.quote: The Data-to-Text generation task focuses on generating human-readable text corresponding to some given structured data.
answer_1.outputs: natural language descriptions from structured knowledge base triples

answer_2.quote: We use several evaluation metrics including BLEU, ROUGE L, METEOR, NIST and CIDEr with the package provided by.

answer_4.quote: We conduct a human evaluation to eval the generation performance. We sample 130 samples from each model's generated sentences and ask human helpers to give an overall score and a match score with respect to the target sentences ranging from 1 to 10.
answer_4.guideline: human helpers are asked to give an overall score and a match score with respect to the target sentences ranging from 1 to 10
